title: Contagious Interview Operators Move Beyond Git Hooks With Trojanized Mac Applications
content_md: North Korea-linked Contagious Interview operators have expanded their developer-targeting malware delivery operation beyond booby-trapped Git hooks and coding repositories, using trojanized macOS applications distributed as disk images and installer packages. Jamf Threat Labs identified 14 malicious DMG and PKG samples impersonating legitimate Mac software, all of which ultimately deliver an OtterCookie-aligned JavaScript implant designed for […] The post Contagious Interview Operators Move Beyond Git Hooks With Trojanized Mac Applications appeared first on GBHackers Security | #1 Globally Trusted Cyber Security News Platform .
